snippet.title: Chess: Apex — Gameplay Trailer | 3D Chess
snippet.description:
Wishlist Chess: Apex on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5145520/Chess_Apex/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=ea_launch_dec2026&utm_content=gameplay_en

Classic 3D chess. After a game, go back to the move that cost you the match and try a different line. Chess: Apex enters Steam Early Access on December 15, 2026.
